owner: Chief Learning Officer + COO-1 Execution Architect
purpose: Task-board manifest for the 10000 learning workforce. It routes learning capacity into proof-based execution instead of duplicate work.
rule: Each learning task has one owner, one canonical output path, proof and a sync target. Learning is not counted unless it changes a reusable rule, product behavior, QA result, revenue path or delivery/deploy proof.

tasks.title: Teach global knowledge core to all workers
tasks.next_action: Use Global Knowledge Core as mandatory reference for every worker exam and project playbook.
tasks.done_proof: Every active project training matrix references Global Knowledge Core.

tasks.title: Certify 10000 workers through exam matrix
tasks.next_action: Require exam modules before workers can close work, teach or change rules.
tasks.done_proof: Exam matrix exists and pass/fail requirements are tied to cohorts.

tasks.title: Sync lessons across all projects
tasks.next_action: Move every reusable lesson through knowledge_sync_bus with affected_projects and proof path.
tasks.done_proof: Lessons have source_project, reusable_rule, affected_projects, sync_status and next_action.

tasks.title: Train Parts Seller OS rules from market learning
tasks.owner: Parts Seller OS Rule Trainers + CEO-A Parts OS General Manager
tasks.next_role: Frontend Agent-C2 / UI and Cockpit Builder
tasks.next_action: Wire training matrix into one-seller UI/workflow and sample data tests.
tasks.done_proof: Each workflow module has rules_to_apply, test_case and QA path.

tasks.title: Expand EU seller learning coverage
tasks.next_action: Grow seller target matrix toward 50 rows, 15 countries and 100 reusable rules.
tasks.done_proof: Verified rows include source_url, checked_at, confidence and rules_to_extract.

tasks.title: Block duplicate learning work
tasks.next_action: Merge duplicate research, route capacity into review/QA/dedupe/unblock tasks, and prevent new unowned docs.
tasks.done_proof: Duplicate tasks are merged and all learning work has canonical output path.

tasks.title: Measure visible learning jump
tasks.next_action: Track reusable_rules_created, synced_lessons, QA blocks, data rows with provenance, prototype rule changes and revenue movement.
tasks.done_proof: Metrics show product behavior changed, not just more documents.

anti_vanity_note: 10 000 is capacity, not proof. Proof is measured by rules synced, workflows changed, QA closed, public demo proof, exact leads and paid-pilot movement.
